Marta: FYI nightlies flagged a big NDCG drop for the split-batch reranker test. +15% NDCG relative to baseline, recall@20 down ~12%. Link to run: s3://redwood-nightlies/rag/1998765432
Ajay: which model? reranker v2 or v2-quant?
Marta: reranker=v2 (non-quant). run artifact: https://ci.internal/redwood/nightlies/1998765432/rerank
Marta: metrics snippet:
```
{"ndcg": 0.62, "ndcg_baseline": 0.73, "recall@20": 0.78, "recall_baseline": 0.89}
```
Leo: any deploys or index changes last night? @Sara
Sara: index refresh at 03:10 UTC (doc store v3.1.4), no reranker deploys; only a model rollout to v2-2026-03-18 (small param tweak)
Ajay: can you dump embeddings drift? compare centroid cos sims.
Marta: attaching small table: topk mean cos sim dropped 0.04; per-shard variance increased. See diff: `delta_mean=-0.040, delta_std=+0.012`
Eval-bot: nightly-run 1998765432 finished with status: anomaly_detected (tags: ndcg_drop, recall_drop)
Leo: hypothesis: index sharding + continuous batching change in retrieval lib -> different negatives for reranker -> training/serving mismatch
Marta: repro plan: 1) replay queries against index snapshot from yesterday 2) run reranker v1 + v2 score compare 3) check embed normalization path
Ajay: I'll take step 1, dumping recall matrices. ETA 2h
Sara: I'll check index refresh logs and shard mapping, ping if I find movement
Marta: if we confirm index changed, rollback is low-risk. If it's reranker, consider canary rollback to v1 and re-eval.
Leo: also try eval on quantized v2-8bit to see if quantization amplifies the issue
Marta: thanks — tagging #incidents if we need emergency rollback :rotating_light:
Ajay: noted. updating thread with matrices soon.
Marta: (added) small repro command:
```
python tools/rerank_eval.py --queries queries/nightly/1998765432.json --index-snapshot s3://redwood-indexes/2026-03-17 --reranker v2 --out out.json
```
Sara: found index snapshot write at 03:09 with different primary shard routing key—looks suspicious, saving logs to s3://redwood-ops/index-logs/1998765432
Leo: good catch. setting up paired eval now.
Marta: last: if anybody sees obvious correlation with embedding model version changes, ping me.
